title: Battle of Sullivan's Island
text: The Battle of Sullivan's Island was fought on June 28, 1776, at Sullivan's Island, South Carolina during the Southern theater of the American Revolutionary War. Taking place near Charles Town, it was fought as part of the first British attempt to capture the city from American forces during the war. The battle is also sometimes referred to as the first siege of Charleston due to a more successful second British siege of the city in 1780.
